newsitem.title: MEXICO: BBV Probursa 1996 net gain vs loss.
newsitem.headline: BBV Probursa 1996 net gain vs loss.

text.p: Grupo Financiero BBV Probursa on Friday reported net profits of 320 million pesos in 1996 versus losses of 1.089 billion pesos in 1995.
It reported reserve coverage of 150 percent of past-due loans.

At a news conference, bank executives said reserve coverage was 1.067 billion pesos, up from 64 percent of past-due loans at year-end 1995. The capitalization index rose to 17 percent from 12 percent at year-end 1995.

Miguel Navas, head of the group's bank unit, said that, under new accounting rules that came into effect in the first quarter of 1997, its reserve coverage would be 70 percent, well above the 45 percent minimum required by law.
"Our 1996 (net profit) number has first of all the merit of breaking a trend of losses and secondly it contains a very important impetus going forward," group president Jose Madariaga said.
